notes.title: Demo Overhaul (again)
notes.content:
[h1]Demo overhaul (again)[/h1][p]Hello everybody! Welcome to the second patch notes for [b][i]From the Top[/i][/b]! [/p][p]So, last time the game did release in a bit of a rough state. Definitely better than the [i]original original[/i] release, but still not quite a polished product. This time around, we’re focusing on rebalancing, bug squashing, and some much-needed QoL improvements![/p][p]One thing to note: this will [b]probably be the last patch notes for the demo[/b] specifically (unless further game breaking bugs are discovered), as we shift focus toward adding more content into the base game rather than adjusting the demo.[/p][p]Anyway, read away![/p][h2]QoL Improvements[/h2][list][*][p][b]Drag & Drop Feedback[/b]
Dragging and dropping tops now shows where they’ll move during the hover, rather than waiting until the mouse button is released.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick Launch Swap[/b]
Moving a top to the first position (i.e., the launch position) can now be done by dropping it into the center of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Select Border Fix[/b]
The selection border around tops now correctly fits the UI element, rather than being oversized—especially important in the shop, drastically improving usability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Stage Visuals[/b]
The boss stage now has a cool new background effect! It looks very red.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VFX Improvements[/b]
Some VFX have been made more visible and impactful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Launch Speed Scaling[/b]
Launch speed now scales with remaining health, you can’t just launch early before the countdown end anymore.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][h3]Parts[/h3][list][*][p][b]Princess[/b][/p][list][*][p]Upper force reduced: 1.4 → 1.2[/p][/*][*][p][i]Flame Princess[/i] has been too centralizing as a starter top. Its role as a strong attacker has been nerfed to align better with other options.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Control[/b][/p][list][*][p]Recovery speed increased: 0.5 → 1[/p][/*][*][p][i]Control Wheel[/i] hasn’t had comparable win rates or usability. This buff should bring it in line while preserving its core weaknesses.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Wheel[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now reduces stamina consumption by 20%[/p][/*][*][p]Despite being the stamina type blade, it lacked any sort of advantage. Now it does! cool and epic![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]STN30 → STN50[/b][/p][list][*][p]The flagship driver for stamina tops now has even more stamina![/p][/*][*][p]Still weak to knock-offs, but now leans harder into its identity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]CTN25 → CTN35[/b][/p][list][*][p]Same reasoning as STN[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stone[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cooldown halved[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn animation duration increased[/p][/*][*][p]Pillars now come out more frequently, but more slowly. Less like parry shields, more like “build your nest.”[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shield[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weight increased 3×[/p][/*][*][p]Shields can now tank hits more passively, letting you recover even if you fail to use your ability in time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Guard Ability[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weight increase reduced from 4× to 2×[/p][/*][*][p]Now has [b]slight movement control[/b] while active![/p][/*][*][p]This balances its buffed base weight with a more manageable guard effect.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Boss Balance[/h3][p]I love the concept of a final boss that’s hard to kill traditionally—but I don’t love that there’s only [i]one[/i] easy method that trivializes it.[/p][list][*][p][b]Health reduced:[/b] 7 → 3[/p][/*][*][p]Now fully upgraded:[/p][list][*][p]50 base stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Super heavy[/p][/*][*][p]Ability is active most of the time[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]This makes each life [i]feel[/i] more impactful and less like a grind.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vile[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added motion damping to its AoE. Reducing effectiveness of direct attacks while active.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewrote the math for its sucking effect (it was frame-rate dependent... oops).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Upgrade Balance Changes[/h3][p]After testing, one thing is clear: upgrades were overtuned for some parts (blade and ability) and almost useless for others (driver). You also can just endlessly upgrade, which is bad They also just cost too much if they weren't meant to be that strong.[/p][list][*][p][b]Blade Upgrade[/b][/p][list][*][p]Weight increase 0.2 → 0.05[/p][/*][*][p]This can literally invalidate type advantage if left uncheck[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ability Upgrade[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ability recovery speed increase 50% -> 30%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Driver Upgrade[/b][/p][list][*][p]stamina increase 5 → 10[/p][/*][*][p]Turns out high stamina isn’t the problem I thought it was.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Every upgrade can only go up to 3 now[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrade base cost $6 → $4[/p][/*][/list][h2]Tops[/h2][list][*][p][b]Replace Storm interceptor with Ice Princess[/b][/p][p]This is a bit of a weird one, but in simple terms I don't like how Flame princess is pretty much your only choice for attack type. Originally Interceptor was made as the second attack type in the demo, as sort of a defense-attack hybrid. Unfortunately, no matter what I try nothing quite feel as good as simply hitting your enemy really hard. so here's another top that can hit enemy hard.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Feature[/h2][list][*][p][b]Meta Progression and save system![/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Codex[/b] now tracks discovered tops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jack[/b] is now an unlockable character who can use any top in your Codex.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress is now saved[/b] between game sessions![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Credits Credits Credits[/b][/p][p]At long last, we now have a [b]credits page[/b]! Thanks to everyone who made [i]FTP[/i] possible. Whether directly on the team or through open-source or public domain work![/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed 'bonus $ earning modifier' on parts[/b][/p][p]The idea for this one was to function as a mini passive benefit for having certain parts on your team. In effect nobody really notice this and it just overwhelms player further with unnecessary information. It has now been removed and gold earning has been increased to compensate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Encounters & Map[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]A new encounter! Sanctuary![/b][/p][p]I've been meaning to add a new encounter that functions as sort of a 'resting place' common to a lot of roguelikes. The new encounter sanctuary allows you to repair all your tops or revive one of your previously broken one. For free![/p][/*][*][p][b]Fight Encounter Streamlining[/b][/p][p]Fights now display a [b]universal encounter icon[/b], rather than describing each fight individually. This reduces visual clutter though at the cost of some player knowledge and decision-making clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Second Stage (Temporarily)[/b][/p][p]For now, this second stage of the demo will be removed until further notice due to development constraint.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Streamlined Tutorial[/b][/p][p]We're adjusting the length of the tutorial and streamlining it down to only the necessary part. This moves it inline with the removal of second stage[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade Encounter Consolidation[/b][/p][p]This effectively reduces the amount of randomness in map choices and give more flexibility when upgrading[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unified Shop[/b][/p][p]Similar to Upgrades, combining both of the shop into one gives more flexibility while reducing randomness in player choice.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fight Encounter[/b] dis-disambigousness[/p][p]Fights now also only display a universal encounter instead of describng each fight individually. Less clutter in exchange for less option and player knowledge[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Tutorial shop[/b] now shows correct starter tops instead of stage 3 ones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-top enemies[/b] are now only defeated after [i]all[/i] their tops are destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spike City (Relic)[/b] now actually works with Stone Fortress.[/p][/*][*][p]You [b]can’t swap tops during end-of-round[/b] to save them from destruction anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy tops [b]no longer spawn under the arena[/b], instantly KOing themselves.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: Now has [b]slight movement control[/b] while active!

tags.bug: [b]Tutorial shop[/b] now shows correct starter tops instead of stage 3 ones.
[b]Multi-top enemies[/b] are now only defeated after [i]all[/i] their tops are destroyed.
[b]Spike City (Relic)[/b] now actually works with Stone Fortress.
You [b]can’t swap tops during end-of-round[/b] to save them from destruction anymore.
Enemy tops [b]no longer spawn under the arena[/b], instantly KOing themselves.

tags.feature: Dragging and dropping tops now shows where they’ll move during the hover, rather than waiting until the mouse button is released.
Moving a top to the first position (i.e., the launch position) can now be done by dropping it into the center of the screen.
The selection border around tops now correctly fits the UI element, rather than being oversized—especially important in the shop, drastically improving usability.
The boss stage now has a cool new background effect! It looks very red.
Some VFX have been made more visible and impactful.
Launch speed now scales with remaining health, you can’t just launch early before the countdown end anymore.
Replace Storm interceptor with Ice Princess
[b]Meta Progression and save system![/b]
[b]Codex[/b] now tracks discovered tops.
[b]Jack[/b] is now an unlockable character who can use any top in your Codex.
[b]Progress is now saved[/b] between game sessions!
[b]Credits Credits Credits[/b]
At long last, we now have a [b]credits page[/b]! Thanks to everyone who made [i]FTP[/i] possible. Whether directly on the team or through open-source or public domain work!
[b]Removed 'bonus $ earning modifier' on parts[/b]

The idea for this one was to function as a mini passive benefit for having certain parts on your team. In effect nobody really notice this and it just overwhelms player further with unnecessary information. It has now been removed and gold earning has been increased to compensate.
[b]Encounters & Map[/b]
[b]A new encounter! Sanctuary![/b]

I've been meaning to add a new encounter that functions as sort of a 'resting place' common to a lot of roguelikes. The new encounter sanctuary allows you to repair all your tops or revive one of your previously broken one. For free!
[b]Fight Encounter Streamlining[/b]

Fights now display a [b]universal encounter icon[/b], rather than describing each fight individually. This reduces visual clutter though at the cost of some player knowledge and decision-making clarity.
[b]Removed Second Stage (Temporarily)[/b]
For now, this second stage of the demo will be removed until further notice due to development constraint.
[b]Streamlined Tutorial[/b]
We're adjusting the length of the tutorial and streamlining it down to only the necessary part. This moves it inline with the removal of second stage
[b]Upgrade Encounter Consolidation[/b]
This effectively reduces the amount of randomness in map choices and give more flexibility when upgrading
[b]Unified Shop[/b]
Similar to Upgrades, combining both of the shop into one gives more flexibility while reducing randomness in player choice.
[b]Fight Encounter[/b] dis-disambigousness
Fights now also only display a universal encounter instead of describng each fight individually. Less clutter in exchange for less option and player knowledge

notes.title: Demo overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Demo overhaul[/h1][p]Hello everybody! Welcome to the first patch notes for [i][b]From the Top[/b][/i]![/p][p]A lot has changed since the original release, and while the game is still in the “If a tree falls in a forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?” stage of development, I want to make sure all existing players of [i]FTP[/i] know that the game is still being actively worked on, it is getting updates.[/p][h1]Balance[/h1][h2]Tops[/h2][p][i]"I actually like when the game make me feel overpowered. I just don't like it when the overpowered thing is the only thing worth using."[/i][/p][p]That’s basically my philosophy when it comes to balance. Since [i]FTP[/i] is a single-player game, this mindset generally isn’t harmful long-term. In any case, here are the changes![/p][h3]Control Wheel[/h3][list][*][p]Increases max stamina from 30 to 40[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces maximum duration of ability from 3s to 1s[/p][/*][/list][h3]Guard Shield[/h3][list][*][p]Added new effect to ability[/p][p][b]Recover Stamina for all tops while activated[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2]Map[/h2][p]One of the annoying things about the original version was how much focus was placed on combat, rather than top-building. You’d get into two fights before encountering a single non-combat event. It meant you spent more time fighting than planning.[/p][p]As one of my friends put it:[/p][p][b]“For a top-battling roguelike, there’s a big lack of [i]roguelike[/i] here.”[/b][/p][p]So I’m flipping that ratio, you’ll now encounter two non-combat events after each battle.[/p][p]As a bonus, this gives me more room to make each fight harder without the game becoming too exhausting. A new mini-boss-style enemy has been added (optional!), with more to come![/p][p][/p][h1]Feature[/h1][h2]Tutorial Rework[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555491/6fa23ccdfc87680f3ac802605d4d3d6db013735b.png"][/img]The game has been received pretty well so far. Battling tops feels great, the dialogue gets a few chuckles, and the game systems show a lot of potential.[/p][p][b]BUT[/b] nobody knows what they’re doing.[/p][p]One thing I want to absolutely nail is the tutorial. At the same time, I know some players prefer figuring things out themselves. So, the tutorial is now its own separate game mode.[/p][p]I’ve also added some helpful instructional text in the first encounter, in case you skip the tutorial but still want a hand.[/p][p][/p][h2]Upgrade[/h2][p][i]New Non-fight encounter alert! New Non-fight encounter alert![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555491/bb7c3594c497be4d00ebe555f3debbd34271b765.gif"][/img][/p][p]We got upgrades! Here you can upgrade individual parts! They're rather generic for now, but I hope to explore more design space like parts specific upgrade down the road. No promises though![/p][p][/p][h2]Characters[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555491/e49c2b65ddc6e2f31c8853b089ca2b4048c2ce2e.png"][/img]We’ve got a character system in the game! Woooooo![/p][p]You can now choose from two starting characters, which means double the build possibilities! (I think.)[/p][p][/p][h1]Visuals[/h1][p]New banners! New Logos! New Top GUI! Countdown timers!! [/p][p]Not gonna get too much into this since I think it's easier to see if you just play the new update ;)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555491/a2f37d781e24dd125f25fe88d59675970c2a1dfa.png"][/img][/p][h1]Release Date Announcement[/h1][p]Announcing your release date for a game that isn't done yet is a bad idea.[/p][p]Unfortunately, I work better with a deadline.[/p][p]So with this, I announce that the game will be released [u][b]November this year[/b][/u]! (Probably, most likely, hopefully)[/p][p]The idea is to time the game's release immediately after 2 big events, SXSW and Steam Next Fest, both happening in October.[/p][p]So something something something, November it is.[/p][p]This might change, hopefully it doesn't.[/p][p][/p][h1]From The Top to be shown in SXSW![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555491/e0fe42198898ae548098620d2d605d6b3b2134ab.png"][/img][b]Yes! From The Top is getting showcased at SXSW this year in Sydney! Hope to see you there![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]P.s. If you want to stay updated with what FTP is up to, be sure to join the [url="https://linktr.ee/platftp"]discord server and follow us on social media[/url] ;)[/p]
